classes.name: Nationalratswahl
classes.finest_note: The BMI publishes results by municipality (Gemeinde) and, for Vienna, by district; polling-district (Wahlsprengel) results are published only by some Länder and cities.
classes.note: Counted per election, as the archive loads one national list-allocation contest per election: seats are allocated in three steps (39 regional constituencies, 9 Land constituencies, and the federal level) under the NRWO 1992. 165 seats from 1923 to 1970 and 183 in 1920 and since 1971. The term is five years since 2007 (four before), and the Council can dissolve itself early. No elections were held from 1934 to 1945.

access.evidence: Results by municipality as XLSX/XLS from 1995 (2024: endgueltiges_ergebnis_beschluss_bundeswahlbehoerde_16102024.xlsx 'mit Gemeindeergebnissen'); earlier elections as scanned PDFs back to 1930 on the historical page.

dates.note: Only 174 of the 183 seats were filled in 1920; the Carinthian and Burgenland seats followed the 1920 plebiscite and the 1921 transfer of Burgenland.

classes.name: Wahl zur Konstituierenden Nationalversammlung
classes.note: The Provisional National Assembly of 1918 was formed from the German-speaking members of the 1911 Reichsrat, not elected. On 16 February 1919, 159 members were elected and 11 more were summoned on 4 April 1919.

dates.quote: 159 Abgeordnete wurden gewählt und mit Beschluss vom 4. April 1919 weitere 11 Abgeordnete einberufen

classes.name: Bundespräsidentenwahl
classes.finest_note: Results by municipality from the BMI.
classes.note: Counted per round: a second round (Stichwahl) four weeks later when no candidate wins an absolute majority (1951, 1986, 1992, 2016). Popular election was introduced by the 1929 amendment but first held in 1951. The 2016 second round was annulled and repeated.

cadence.runoff_rule: Absolute majority of valid votes; otherwise a runoff between the two leading candidates (Art. 60 Abs. 2 B-VG).

access.evidence: Municipal results as XLS/XLSX from 1998; earlier rounds on the historical page.

dates.note: Annulled by the Constitutional Court on 1 July 2016 (W I 6/2016).
Repeat of the annulled second round (Wiederholung zweiter Wahlgang).

classes.name: Wahl des Bundespräsidenten durch die Bundesversammlung
classes.name_en: Election of the Federal President by the Federal Assembly (1920-1945)
classes.note: The Federal Assembly (National Council and Federal Council in joint session) elected the president in 1920, 1924, 1928, 1931, and 1945. The 1931 popular election provided for by the 1929 amendment was cancelled. The Parliament's pages give the 1945 date; the 1920-1931 ballots are listed as a span until a cited date list is found.

dates.quote: Die Volkswahl wurde mit der B-VG-Novelle 1929 eingeführt, gelangte aber erst 1951 erstmals tatsächlich zur Anwendung.
Am 20. Dezember wählte die Bundesversammlung Karl Renner zum Bundespräsidenten.

classes.name: Europawahl in Österreich
classes.finest_note: Results by municipality from the BMI.
classes.note: Counted per election: Austria elects its members as one national constituency by list PR with preference votes. The 1996 by-election followed accession on 1 January 1995; until then members were delegated by the National Council.

classes.name: Volksabstimmung
classes.note: Binding referendum on a law passed by the National Council (Art. 43 B-VG, on request of its majority) or mandatory on a total revision of the constitution (Art. 44 Abs. 3 B-VG). Held twice: Zwentendorf nuclear plant (1978) and EU accession (1994).

die am 12. Juni 1994 abgehaltene Volksabstimmung betreffend den Beitritt Österreichs zur Europäischen Union

classes.name: Volksbefragung
classes.note: Non-binding consultation on a matter of national importance, decided by the National Council (Art. 49b B-VG, since 1989). Held once, on conscription versus a professional army (2013). Its selector is limited to 2013 so later consultations need a new date range here.

dates.quote: Bisher haben in Österreich zwei Volksabstimmungen und eine Volksbefragung stattgefunden

classes.name: Volksbegehren
classes.name_en: Citizens' initiatives (signatures collected over an eight-day period)
classes.finest_note: The BMI publishes the signatures per municipality for initiatives since 2018, per political district for 1996 to 2017 (per state for four of them), and only the national count for 1964 to 1995.
classes.note: An initiative signed by 100,000 voters (or a sixth of the voters in each of three Länder) must be dealt with by the National Council (Art. 41 Abs. 2 B-VG). Each one counts once; registrations still collecting supporting declarations without a set signing period are not counted. The loader gives each initiative the office "Citizens' initiative (Volksbegehren)", which the name selector matches, so these contests do not fall to the volksabstimmung class.

access.evidence: 114 initiatives with a signing period, 1964 to June 2026, with valid signatures and turnout.

classes.name: Landtagswahlen
classes.finest_note: The Länder publish results by municipality; Vienna and some Länder also by polling district.
classes.note: Each of the nine Länder elects its Landtag by list PR (Art. 95 B-VG), for five years (six in Upper Austria). Vienna's Landtag is its Gemeinderat, elected once for both roles. Elections began in 1919 (Burgenland from 1922, Vienna as a Land from 1922) and resumed in 1945. Counted per election; the days are listed for Tyrol since 1989 (its election page) and Salzburg for 2023 (its Landtag page); the other Länder's days remain uncounted spans.

access.evidence: The index page answers; the result pages under /wahlergebnis/ answered 403 to a cloud session on 2026-11-16.

dates.quote: Am 23. April 2023 fand die Landtagswahl statt.

classes.name: Wahl der Landesregierung und des Landeshauptmannes durch den Landtag
classes.name_en: Election of the state governor and government by the Landtag
classes.note: Each Landtag elects the Landeshauptmann and the members of the Land government (Art. 101 B-VG); some Länder fill government seats by party strength (Proporz). The Landtag's records give each ballot.

classes.name: Gemeinderatswahlen (Gemeindevertretungswahlen)
classes.note: Every municipality elects its council by list PR (Art. 117 Abs. 2 B-VG); EU citizens vote. Each Land fixes a common election day for its municipalities by Land law, and the statutory cities (Statutarstädte) have their own statutes and days (Graz voted on 28 June 2026). Vienna's Gemeinderat is its Landtag and is counted under landtage, so the expected count is the municipalities outside Vienna.

classes.name: Bürgermeister-Direktwahl
classes.note: Land law may provide for the people to elect the mayor (Art. 117 Abs. 6 B-VG). Burgenland, Carinthia, Upper Austria, Salzburg, Tyrol, and Vorarlberg do, on separate ballots on the council election day, with a runoff (Stichwahl, 'engere Wahl') two weeks later when no candidate wins an absolute majority (Tyrol: 13 March 2022 after 27 February 2022). Lower Austria, Styria, and Vienna have their councils elect the mayor. Those six Länder held 1,233 municipalities on 1 January 2026 (171 + 132 + 438 + 119 + 277 + 96), so the class is listed as a span rather than counted from the 2,092 municipalities.

classes.name: Wahl des Bürgermeisters und Gemeindevorstandes durch den Gemeinderat
classes.name_en: Election of mayors and executive boards by municipal councils
classes.disposition_reason: Council-internal votes (Art. 117 Abs. 6 B-VG) in Lower Austria, Styria, Vienna, and some statutory cities; minutes are kept by each municipality and no authority publishes them as election results.

classes.name: Bezirksvertretungswahlen in Wien
classes.note: Each of Vienna's 23 districts elects its Bezirksvertretung by list PR on the day of the Gemeinderat election; EU citizens vote here but not for the Gemeinderat. The City publishes results from 1996 to 2025.

access.evidence: Index lists Bezirksvertretungswahlen 2025, 2020, 2015, 2010, 2005, 2001, 1996; result pages under /wahlergebnis/ (BV251, BV201) answered 403 to a cloud session.

classes.name: Bezirksratswahlen in Graz
classes.note: Graz's city districts elect their Bezirksräte on the day of the Gemeinderat election (most recently 28 June 2026), with one sample ballot per district on the City's page (17).

classes.name: Landesvolksabstimmungen, Landesvolksbefragungen und Landesvolksbegehren
classes.note: Each Land constitution provides for referendums, consultations, or initiatives (for example Vienna's consultations of 2010 and 2013, 'Wien will's wissen', which the City lists with its results).

classes.name: Gemeindevolksabstimmungen und -befragungen
classes.disposition_reason: No register or central publisher: each municipality calls and announces its own votes under Land law, and the Länder do not compile them.

classes.name: Entsendung in den Bundesrat
classes.name_en: Federal Council members chosen by the Landtage
classes.disposition_reason: Each Landtag fills its Federal Council seats by its parties' strength after its own election (Art. 35 B-VG); there is no contested vote to record.

classes.name: Arbeiterkammer-, Wirtschaftskammer-, Landwirtschaftskammer-, Berufskammer- und ÖH-Wahlen
classes.disposition_reason: Statutory self-governing bodies (chambers of labour, commerce, agriculture, and the professions, and the Austrian Students' Union) run these elections for their own members, not the electoral authorities for a territorial electorate.

classes.name: Volksabstimmung vom 10. April 1938
classes.disposition_reason: Held by the German Reich after the annexation, together with the single-list Reichstag vote; the archive counts it in the German census (census.de, reich_volksentscheid).

classes.name: Wahlen zum Abgeordnetenhaus des Reichsrates
classes.name_en: Elections to the House of Deputies of the Imperial Council (Reichsrat)
classes.note: From 1861 to 1873 the Landtage delegated the deputies; direct election by curiae began in 1873, a fifth general curia was added in 1897, and equal male suffrage applied in 1907 and 1911. The House covered all of Cisleithania, including today's Czechia, Slovenia, and southern Poland. The 1848 Constituent Reichstag is noted here and not counted.

dates.quote: Erst 1873 wurde weitgehend die direkte Wahl der Abgeordneten, also ohne Umweg über die Landtage, eingeführt.

classes.name: Landtagswahlen in den Kronländern
classes.disposition_reason: No official compilation: the diets of the seventeen crown lands were elected by curiae under their own Landesordnungen, and their returns survive only in each diet's records, most of them outside today's Austria.
